name: Hardware-Assisted Progressive Volume Rendering
aliases: Hardware-Assisted Progressive Volume Rendering (Callahan et al.)
definition: A client-server architecture for hardware-assisted, progressive volume rendering that minimizes data size on the client by transmitting geometry incrementally. The server acts as a data repository and the client accumulates incoming geometry to display a progressively improving image.
summary: Hardware-Assisted Progressive Volume Rendering is a client-server method that minimizes storage by incrementally transmitting isosurface geometry, using Hardware-Assisted Visibility Sorting to refine images progressively.
